evidence.curator_note: Equation 8.37, line 3 of 3: 'OE+.  AB--C(+.)D  --sigma-->  AB. + CD+'. Same net outcome as line 1 (radical loss + even-electron carbenium, NO new pi bond) but drawn with the charge AND the odd electron BOTH localized on a single atom C (the superscript reads '+.' on C), i.e. the localized-valence picture of the OE ion rather than line 1's charge-on-the-bond picture. Homolysis of the drawn AB--C sigma bond expels AB. and leaves C's radical electron paired with the retained bonding electron -> closed-shell cation CD+. ARC COUNT (convention D): the book draws 0 curved arrows/fishhooks (straight sigma-labelled reaction arrow only). The 2 encoded electron_moves are IMPLICIT: move <1> routes one electron of the cleaving AB--C bond OUT of the system (external = the ionization hole), move <2> routes the other onto the departing carbon to form the radical; the retained carbon becomes the cation. INSTANTIATION (convention F): scheme is generic (A,B,C,D undefined, no m/z/intensity printed). Instantiated as the n-BUTANE radical cation cleaving a TERMINAL C1-C2 bond, mapping AB=CH3 (map 1, the leaving .CH3 radical), C=the adjacent carbon (map 2, the localized charge/radical centre), D=CH2CH3 (maps 3,4) -> so CD+ = n-propyl cation C3H7+. This is butane's dominant fragmentation (loss of CH3.); curator-computed detected ion m/z 43.0542 (C3H7+), derived from the instantiation, not from the page. LOCALIZATION (convention B): although the book localizes +/. on the single carbon C, a valence-correct SMILES for a di-coordinate carbon bearing both '+' and an unpaired electron is a non-physical graph abstraction (cf. the caveat in IMS4-EQ4.3); the precursor is therefore encoded as the neutral butane skeleton with charge/radical in the fields plus an external-hole electron move, the same house convention as line 1 and IMS4-EQ4.3.

NO MOD rule is indexed for Equation 8.37 (rule_index.json 'by_equation' stops at 8.14; no 8.37 key). No cross-link is asserted. The chapter-4 sigma dissociation rules IMS_4_3_var1/var2 encode the same class of transformation (OE+. -> EE+ carbenium + neutral radical) but are keyed to 4.3 (propane), not to 8.37 (butane). m/z 43.0542 (C3H7+) is curator-computed from the n-butane terminal-cleavage instantiation.
